newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 20 bln lire of Italy 3-yr Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 20 bln lire of Italy 3-yr Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 20 billion lire of three-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 150 billion lire of paper, and there were no bids for 200 billion of five-year Btps.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.43 trillion lire at the open auction for the October 1, 1999 paper, against 1.5 trillion lire worth of Btps on offer.
The auction price was set at 102.45 from 101.35 at the previous auction on October 16.
